escalations.formula: Escalations taken in the run: each raise task that ran, to the lead or to the owner. A raise that did not run is not counted.

spec-rework.formula: Times the spec was reopened after spec-check had passed it.

acceptance-coverage.formula: Criteria in the approved item that have at least one acceptance test, divided by all criteria in the item.

red-for-wrong-reason.formula: Red runs in which the new test did not fail on an assertion: it ended with a compile error, an import error or a timeout, or it passed.

acceptance-rounds.formula: Build rounds until the acceptance suite is green. When the suite is never green within the round bound, the value is the bound and the run raises acceptance-not-met.

defects-found-in-review.formula: Findings of the whole-change review that the owner's verdict upheld. A finding is upheld when the verdict is reject for it or the owner confirms it; one per distinct file, line and criterion.

defects-escaped.formula: Defects filed against a merged change within 30 days of its merge, counted per change.

lead-time.formula: Merge time minus the time of work-item-ready.

decision-latency.formula: Time from the gate opening to the signed decision.

write-set-collisions.formula: Pairs of units in the cut whose write-sets overlap: they share a file, or one lists a directory that contains a path of the other. Counted from the paths in the cut.

review-rounds.formula: Number of review rounds on the change until the review verdict is approve. The review floor runs once per run, so a value above 1 counts earlier runs of the same item.

report-complete.formula: Required sections with a non-empty body in the final report, divided by all six: Summary, Acceptance, Tests, Defects, Metrics, Not verified.

proposals-accepted.formula: Improver proposals that were applied, divided by all proposals made. A proposal on the free rung counts as accepted when it was applied; an ordinary one when the reviewer approved it; a protected one when the owner signed it. With zero proposals made the value is not recorded.

tests-per-unit.formula: Tests added or changed in a unit.

diff-lines.formula: Lines added plus lines removed in a unit.

green-rounds.formula: Green attempts of one unit until the suite passes with no test file edited. Each failed green-evidence in a cycle round counts one.
